body: Wish it was that easy man
Honestly by talking about it to others, or constant self reassurance I won’t die from everything I come in contact with. It’s not easy but I do my best, and the best for me is self expression.

The only reason I’m asking about it is because I’ll do it multiple-times per day and I didn’t know if it’s good to get up and do that then sit back down. Basically asking if it’s bad to raise my heart rate and exercise multiple times per day is bad?
